🎬 Animal Kingdom (2010–2022) — Crime, Drama, Thriller
After losing his mother, 17-year-old Joshua “J” Cody is sent to live with his grandmother and her criminal family in Melbourne. At first, the Cody household appears to offer him protection and a place to belong, but J soon discovers that the family is deeply involved in dangerous criminal activities.
As J becomes more exposed to the family's world, he realizes that loyalty comes with a price. Surrounded by people he cannot completely trust, he must carefully navigate relationships with his uncles and grandmother while trying to protect himself from the consequences of their actions.
The series explores family, loyalty, power, manipulation, survival, and the influence of one's environment. J's story shows how difficult it can be to escape a criminal lifestyle when the people closest to you are the ones pulling you deeper into it.
More than just a crime drama, Animal Kingdom is about a young man trying to survive inside a family where love and danger are often impossible to separate. 🐺🔥

source_details.synopsis: Animal Kingdom is a 2010 Australian crime drama film written and directed by David Michôd in his feature directorial debut. It stars Ben Mendelsohn, Joel Edgerton, Guy Pearce, James Frecheville, Luke Ford, Jacki Weaver, and Sullivan Stapleton. The screenplay was inspired by several crimes allegedly committed by the Pettingill family of Melbourne, particularly one involving brothers Trevor Pettingill and Victor Peirce, and two other men, Anthony Leigh Farrell and Peter David McEvoy, all of whom were acquitted in 1988 of murdering two police officers in the Walsh Street police shootings.
